rationale: The claim is a magnitude interpretation of Table 3 column 2: the column-2 (manufacturing-share-controlled) coefficient on import exposure times the 2000-2007 interquartile exposure difference (~1.06 kUSD) should yield a -0.65 pp differential decline. The evidence file log/tab_ipw_manuf_2.scsv reproduces the column (2) coefficient on d_t~eusch_pw as exactly -0.610 (SE 0.094), matching the paper's -0.610. Multiplying by the interquartile exposure difference of 1.06 kUSD (Appendix Table 1: (3.11-1.60)x0.7 = 1.06) gives -0.610 x 1.06 = -0.6466 pp, which rounds to -0.65 (relative error ~0.5% vs the paper value -0.65). Both the coefficient and the derived differential reproduce, so this is a match.
